hook.headline: Save time by bringing your Orca profiles with you
altHeadlines: Stop setting up filament profiles one by one
Keep the filament choices you already use

features.heading: Choose the profiles you want
benefitLines: Only the printers and nozzles you use
features.rationale: Users can choose eligible built-in or custom Orca profiles and selected official printer and nozzle targets.

features.heading: Skip setting them up again
benefitLines: Check the names before you start
features.rationale: The tool resolves existing settings and prepares multiple selected outputs in one reviewed plan.

features.heading: More useful choices in Bambu Studio
benefitLines: More than Bambu and Generic profiles
Bambu Studio updates its list as usual
features.rationale: Local custom filament identities can be loaded by Bambu Studio and continue through its normal synchronization flow; AMS confirmation remains manual.

positioning.differentiator: Choose the built-in or custom Orca profiles you already use, bring several into Bambu Studio together, and avoid typing the same filament settings again.

audience.who: Bambu users who want their preferred Orca filament profiles available alongside the usual Bambu and Generic choices.
painPoints: Re-entering known filament settings one profile at a time takes unnecessary effort.
The default Bambu list may not include the Orca profiles a user already trusts.
Users want to choose only the filaments, printers, and nozzle sizes they actually use.

use: check the names before you start

objections.objection: Can I choose my own custom Orca profiles?
objections.response: Yes. Choose eligible built-in Orca profiles, your own custom profiles, or both.

objections.objection: Does this put profiles into AMS automatically?
objections.response: No. Bambu Studio handles its usual update and sync, then you confirm the result in AMS.

objections.objection: Will it change every profile it finds?
objections.response: No. You choose the profiles, printers, and nozzle sizes you want before you start.

switchingForces.push: Typing the same trusted settings again for each Bambu profile wastes effort.
switchingForces.pull: Choose several existing Orca profiles and prepare them together.
switchingForces.habit: Rebuilding profiles by hand is familiar even when it repeats work.
switchingForces.anxiety: Users want to check names and choices before anything is prepared.

proofPoints.claim: Users can filter and select eligible OrcaSlicer and Bambu Studio filament profiles.
Users can create profiles for selected official printers and nozzle diameters.
Bambu Studio performs its own normal synchronization and AMS verification remains operator-confirmed.

narration.text: Save time by bringing your Orca filament profiles with you instead of rebuilding them one by one.
Choose built-in or custom Orca profiles. Pick only the printers and nozzles you use.
